verdict.reason: Rey Cortiço is worth a quick check for mid-morning — 11:00, but it is not a guaranteed session.  Treat it as a check-first call rather than a sure thing.  The wind should help keep it tidy.  The tide should let the sandbars work without overdoing it.

conversationalSummary.text: TODAY, I’d do a cam check first and only then head out—Rey Cortiço mid-morning around 11:00 looks like the best available option, but Surfline consistency is a bit sketchy. The wind looks nicely glassy, and with the tide mid-dropping you might catch some punchy, rippable peaks if the sandbanks line up. I’d check Surfline (and MEO Beachcam for backup) before committing, and go only if it looks much cleaner than expected.
